seoTitle: Heatmap Maker: Colour a Table of Numbers (SVG)
metaDescription: Paste a grid with row and column labels to colour each cell by value with a legend and optional numbers. Free SVG heatmap.
intro: Shades every cell of a numeric grid by its value. Pick a colour scale, show or hide the numbers, and get a legend and a table.
why:
A heatmap helps you find the hot and cold cells in a cross-tab, a correlation matrix or a schedule. The numbers can stay in the cells so the picture never replaces the data.

Text inside each cell switches between dark and light for readable contrast. Scales include a sequential blue, viridis-style, heat, grey and a diverging blue-white-red scale centred on zero. Colour alone is a weak channel, so keep the values on for anything you must read exactly.
howTo: Paste a grid: first row column labels, first column row labels.
Choose a colour scale; use diverging for values around zero.
Show values in cells if the grid is small enough.
